name: sumline
description: An open-source, browser-based notepad calculator in the spirit of Soulver

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sumline/engine && npm run build -w @sumline/web && npm run build -w @sumline/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @sumline/engine && npm run test -w @sumline/server && npm run test -w @sumline/web
